correctness.rationale: For any absolutely continuous X and continuous polynomial F, bounded CF kernel gives ||CFD X(t)||→0 as t↓0; thus continuous solution of CFD X=F(X) requires F(X0)=0. Checked original Ahmad et al parameter Table1 and Figures1–3 X0=(100,0,1), and independently computed rational vector (.109,.027,-2). Therefore no AC fractional solution for stated initial data, not a claim for gamma=1. Read source equations (3.4), (4.3), (4.4)–(4.6): (3.4) subtracts Xi(0) inconsistent with Definition 2.2 as printed; (4.3) uses an exponential weighted history unlike unweighted integral in that definition; (4.6) replaces its increment by unweighted newest interval. Splitting weighted integral proves exactly Q(t+h)-Q(t)=(e^-kh-1)Q(t)+∫new exp(-k(t+h-s))Xi(s)ds, with omitted term = -kh Q(t)+O(h²) and counterexample Xi=1. Results concern printed scheme, not arbitrary fractional HIV models.
